groups.note: Supreme Court justices are the five who were in office this January, using official Wyoming Judicial Branch appointment and retirement dates together with Weston County retention results. Circuit, district, and magistrate rows are limited to judges who appeared on a Weston County official retention ballot in an adjoining cycle, plus the Weston circuit-court listing for Judge Bush when that listing applies; those local benches may be incomplete.
